build_cache_empty: build an empty intermediate values cache with a specified number of batches and offload device
create_cache_from_dataloader: create a cache prepopulated with intermediate values from a PyTorch DataLoader
fetch_intermediate_values: fetch offloaded intermediate values for a specific batch and optional input names
update_cache_batch: update a cache batch with new intermediate values that are offloaded to the specified device
iterate_prefetch_batches: iterate over cached batches with background prefetching to overlap H2D transfers with compute
